disclosure: Generated by an AI agent (OpenHands) on behalf of the user.
eligibility: task_type=count, multi_task_load=1, features=single_count_<one of six declared features>. No label/value/parseability/agreement filtering.
failure_policy: Retain all selected rows, never replace or relabel. Zero automated retries. Future infrastructure retries must use the same frozen tasks and be reported separately.

features.branch_point: Number of carbon atoms with graph degree at least 3, including ring atoms; bond order does not affect degree.
features.carbon_atom: Number of atoms with atomic number 6.
features.chain_termini: Number of carbon atoms with graph degree exactly 1, including ring-attached terminal carbons.
features.halogen_atom: Number of F, Cl, Br, or I atoms (not other group-17 elements).
features.heavy_atom: Number of atoms with atomic number greater than 1.
features.hetero_atom: Number of atoms whose atomic number is neither 1 nor 6.

finite_domain: Exactly one requested property key, integer in [0,N], N=parsed graph atom count. Each property counts a subset of its atoms.
sampling: Python random.Random(20261009).sample over UID-sorted complete eligible source rows, 100 without replacement. Repeated molecules retained; no independence claim.
scope: Six scalar atom-count features only; not full MolecularIQ.
semantics: Parse metadata.smiles with RDKit 2025.09.4 default MolFromSmiles. Ordinary removable explicit H is removed; isotopic H is retained. Degree counts retained atom neighbors. Use presented SMILES, not original_smiles.
serialization: Bare UTF-8 JSON object in /app/answer.json, no tags/prose. Reject duplicate/extra/wrong keys, bools, floats, NaN, infinity, oversized files. Declared Harbor serialization change.
